description: Control soak for soak-go: identical workload with go-redis instead of GLIDE. Launch on its own instance in parallel; a flat control with a rising GLIDE series isolates the growth to GLIDE rather than the engine/harness. Launch with --runtime-cap 780. infra/provision.sh does not install the Go toolchain yet, so this matrix fails on bench-aws.sh until that block is added; run it locally with make benchmark-matrix.
